title: Separate provider bindings and clean legacy Terraform anchors
creator: Aisha Nair
description:
Problem: multiple repositories and workspaces embed provider version constraints and ad-hoc provider aliases in root anchors.tf files. This causes frequent provider version conflicts during module upgrades, surprises in provider selection across modules, and brittle workspace-level scripts.

Goal: introduce a small, composable 'provider-binding' module and a migration plan that: 1) centralizes provider version pinning and aliasing per-cloud-region; 2) strips legacy anchors.tf files out of service stacks and replaces them with explicit module calls; 3) upgrades AWS provider to a tested stable minor (v4.x -> v5.x candidate) in a controlled canary; 4) add CI checks (terraform fmt/init/validate/plan) and a terratest harness.

Success criteria: all production workspaces have no anchors.tf at root, provider version conflicts eliminated in terraform init for infra repo, successful canary apply in staging without drift, provider upgrade runbook validated, CI prevents accidental provider changes, and a post-migration runbook published.

2025-02-06 - Maya Hernandez (review): Raised concerns about provider alias semantics for cross-account routing and suggested explicit alias naming pattern 'aws.<region>.<account_role>'. Also requested terratest cases for assume-role flows.

2025-02-08 - Daniel Park: Updated module to support alias naming pattern and optional assume_role configuration. Added terratest skeleton and unit plan check in CI. New PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1142

2025-02-10 - Security review (Liam O'Connor): Verified module does not alter IAM policy or credentials; recommended documenting KMS/HSM provider interactions for Private deployment workspaces. Marked security_review_required=false on ticket.

2025-02-12 - Infra SIG sync: Decided migration plan: (1) land provider-binding module in infra main, (2) update a single staging workspace (staging-west) to use module and bump aws provider to 5.2.0 for canary, (3) run full terratest suite, (4) iterate to other regions by alphabetical order. Assigned rollout owner: Daniel Park.

2025-02-15 - CI update: Added explicit terraform init with -upgrade=false guard for all PRs, and a new check that errors if provider version constraint changes without a changelog entry. See CI config PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1160
